about: Versions of the website. Each is a frozen copy of the home page (site/versions/<version>.html) with its own images and, from 1.2.1, of About, Contact us, Ambassadors and the legal pages (site/versions/pages/<pages>/, named by "pages"; versions without it use the copy 1.2.0, the pages as they were before 1.2.1). The live one is chosen in Console → Settings → Website content. site/index.html, site/pages and site/legal are the working draft (previewed at /v/draft/, /v/draft/about/ …). footerPages: the footer links to About and Contact us; liveChat: the website chat; ambassadors: "Ambassador" in the top menu and "Become an ambassador" in the phone menu and footer when the programme is on, and the footer's Product list without How it works, Pricing and Why trust us (added 18 Oct 2026). official: Hoolam's one WhatsApp number in the footer (added 21 Oct 2026). The draft always has all of them. A version is only added here after the owner confirms a round of changes is complete.
